name: Google Drive sync
author: Sascha Manns
description: Two-way Google Drive sync for any number of folders, built on rclone bisync, on a timer and when local files change

barWidget.description: Drive icon in the bar showing the sync state. Opens a panel to connect a Google account, manage folder pairs, sync now, and see conflicts. Middle-click syncs everything.

schema.label: rclone remote
schema.description: Name of the rclone remote to use. Connecting from the panel creates it; an existing Google Drive remote of that name (for example one with your own client id) is used as it is.

schema.label: Sync every
schema.description: Minutes between full syncs, which is what picks up changes made on Drive. 0 turns the timer off.

schema.label: Sync on local changes
schema.description: Watch the local folders with inotify and sync a folder shortly after something in it changed.

schema.label: Wait after a change
schema.description: Seconds of quiet after the last local change before the folder is synced.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Notify when a sync fails, when new conflicts appear, and when a failing folder syncs again.
